content:
name: Repository integrity

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integrity:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Enforce canonical ADR root
        run: |
          test ! -e adrs
          test -d architecture/decisions
          test -f architecture/decisions/ADR-0001-knowledge-engine-core.md
      - name: Validate planning generators
        run: |
          python3 scripts/migrate-mvp-identifiers.py
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
      - name: Validate machine projection freshness
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
      - name: Validate EOS
        run: ./scripts/eos ci
